newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bad loans 115.4 trln lire in May - BankItaly.
newsitem.headline: Italy bad loans 115.4 trln lire in May - BankItaly.

text.p: Bad loans held by Italian banks totalled 115.421 trillion lire in May after 113.088 trillion lire in April, and compared to 100.005 trillion lire in May 1995, data from the Bank of Italy showed.
Banks holding short-term deposits were carrying bad loans of 99.523 trillion lire in May from 97.153 trillion lire in April and 84.198 trillion lire in May 1995.
Banks holding medium-to-long term deposits had some 15.898 trillion lire of bad laos from 15.935 trillion lire in April and 15.807 tillion lire a year ago.
